The edges of the lower bandage blend into the skin rather than sitting on top of it. There is no clear shadow or depth separation, suggesting the bandage is 'painted on' or melting into the face geometry.
The eyes appear slightly asymmetrical and the gaze direction is ambiguous. The reflection in the eyes is inconsistent, and the eyelid structures look slightly malformed.
